claims.assertion: Yazhi said she was not opposed to electric vehicles generally, but claimed terrestrial EVs can be remotely disabled and used to restrict public mobility.
claims.speaker: Yazhi Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: This is her argument about their terrestrial use.

claims.assertion: She argued that high costs, planned obsolescence, and lithium scarcity would leave private EV ownership mainly to wealthy people after restrictions on combustion cars.
claims.speaker: Yazhi Swaruu

claims.assertion: Yazhi claimed lithium extraction, battery production, and disposal make EVs environmentally damaging despite their clean image.
claims.speaker: Yazhi Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: This environmental assessment is her claim.

review_flags: Remote-shutdown and environmental claims are attributed to Yazhi and not presented as established facts.
